description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing lessons in a learning management system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and attaching storage paths to lessons, with role-based access control indicated via headers.

methods.name: get_lessons(x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all lessons, with role-based filtering.

methods.name: post_lesson(payload: LessonCreate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new lesson, restricted to Admin role.

methods.name: put_lesson(lesson_id: str, payload: LessonUpdate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing lesson, restricted to Admin role.

methods.name: remove_lesson(lesson_id: str, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a lesson, restricted to Admin role.

methods.name: attach_file(lesson_id: str, payload: LessonUpdate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to attach a storage path to a lesson, restricted to Admin role.

calls: update_lesson(x_role, lesson_id, {k: v for k, v in payload.dict().items() if v is not None})

ctags.pattern: /^def post_lesson(payload: LessonCreate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Rol/

ctags.pattern: /^def put_lesson(lesson_id: str, payload: LessonUpdate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=Non/
ctags.signature: (lesson_id: str, payload: LessonUpdate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"))

ctags.name: remove_lesson
ctags.pattern: /^def remove_lesson(lesson_id: str, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role")):$/
